attorneys: Messrs. John W. Dunkle and Ward Bonsall for petitioner., Solicitor General Hughes, and Messrs. Claude R. Branch, Howard T. Jones, and John J. Byrne for the United States.

opinions.text: The petition for a writ of certiorari herein to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit is granted, with the limitation, however, that counsel shall confine themselves, in the briefs and in oral argument, to the question whether the property seized is forfeitable under § 25, Title II, of the national prohibition act.
